state: The commit adds .env, and that file contains DATABASE_URL with a database password.
Every POST /cleanup calls shutil.rmtree on the customer uploads directory.
The bank callback uses requests.get(url, verify=False).
The new trace line prints the Authorization header of the incoming request.
The calculator route passes request.form['expr'] to eval.
A new sales-tax function is added. The pull request contains no test for it.
The code returns the price in cents. The test still expects euros and was not updated.
The HTTP timeout is set to 0, and a timeout is treated as a successful charge.
Email dedupe compares strings without case folding. The reported bug was Case@x.com versus case@x.com.
The webhook returns HTTP 200 before the signature check runs.
Search compiles the raw query as a regular expression and does not escape it. No test was added.
getUser is renamed to get_user. The existing tests pass.
A test is added for the empty-cart total the function already returns. No production code changed.
A comment typo, "recieve", is corrected to "receive". No code path changed.
The only file in the diff is CHANGELOG.md, noting a release that is already deployed.
A local literal already covered by tests is moved to a named constant. The tests pass.
A branch the coverage report marks unreachable is deleted. The suite still passes.
